title: General form of Marston’s formula

symbols.definition: Vertical load in kgs per metre length acting on the conduit due to gravity earth loads
Width of trench or conduit in meters depending upon the type of installation conditions, m

Dimensionless co-efficient that measures the effect of (a) Ratio of height of fill to width of trench or conduit (b) Shearing forces between interior and adjacent earth prisms and (c) Direction and amount of relative settlement between interior and adjacent earth prisms for embankment conditions.

applicability: Vertical load on buried conduits due to gravity earth forces. Calculated backfill load is the ultimate-settlement load; lateral pressure is computed by Rankine’s theory; negligible cohesion except for tunnel conditions.
